tasks.short: Direct aerial surveys of specified areas.

steps.what: Confirm the actual geographical survey area, deliverables, access constraints and crew responsibilities
Assemble the crew direction brief from the specified area and already approved equipment and acquisition specifications
inputs: existing approved equipment and altitude specifications

steps.what: Direct aerial surveys of the specified geographical area with the actual crew and resolve acquisition changes
inputs: actual crew reports and acquisition conditions
outputs: actual survey direction decisions and acquisition references

steps.what: Review actual acquired coverage and metadata against the specified area and identify gaps needing human resolution
inputs: actual survey direction decisions and acquisition references
actual image footprints and timestamps in survey software {OTHER}
outputs: verified acquisition coverage and outstanding gaps

steps.what: Write and check the actual direction outcome, coverage gaps, decisions and follow-up in the project note
inputs: verified acquisition coverage and outstanding gaps
outputs: checked final survey-direction note and exact project record

steps.what: Save the checked actual survey-direction note in the internal project record
inputs: checked final survey-direction note and exact project record

tasks.design: Reuse approved acquisition specifications in a native {DOCS} direction brief and show actual coverage in the survey workspace {OTHER}. Keep crew direction, changes and the actual outcome note human; planned flight lines are never treated as acquired data.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specifications may be recopied and acquired coverage checked across separate views.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates and image-footprint views can reduce these mechanics.
tasks.still_hard: Weather, access, incomplete acquisition and crew coordination.
tasks.human_edge: Making practical decisions with the crew under actual conditions.

ambition.what: Review one acquisition gap while the crew can still resolve it.

tasks.altitude: Less briefing layout and coverage navigation; existing direction authority stays unchanged.

reach.learn: Distinguish planned lines from timestamped acquired footprints.

evidence.claim: Native survey views can display acquired footprints against an area boundary; this does not direct a crew or establish complete image quality.

assumptions: Boundary is the surveyor's direction and actual coverage review. Pilot and crew labour, flying, image capture and processing runtime are outside the focal denominator and receive no saving. Equipment and altitude determination under 3550 is an existing input, not repeated work here.

The project owner supplies area geometry and deliverables; the specification owner supplies approved sensor and altitude revision; actual acquisition systems and operators supply image ID, timestamp, footprint and acquisition status. Missing metadata is manually checked, and no coverage is inferred from a plan.
Test native templates and coverage views first. No model or flight command is introduced. Existing operational and aviation permissions remain required.

a1 binds the completed actual outcome note and project destination checked during authoring in s5. Edits require rechecking; the ordinary save receives no benefit. No separate crew-message send is automated or credited.
unknowns: Actual availability of acquired footprint metadata and existing coverage views.
research_questions: Can the native view expose genuine acquisition gaps without presenting planned coverage as evidence?

already_counted.description: Prepare the brief, review actual coverage and write and check the actual outcome note.

incremental.description: Maintain specification links and actual-footprint status mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Final actual survey-direction note, coverage exceptions and exact project record checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Brief mechanics save 4.5 points and coverage-view mechanics 3.75; gross 8.25 less 1 upkeep. Low is no adoption if native facilities already cover the work or metadata must be manually captured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define the actual surveying or mapping method question and comparison requirements
Find and review relevant surveying, photogrammetric map compilation and electronic data processing references
inputs: actual technical references in literature database {OTHER}

steps.what: Design the method comparison and verify the actual source images, control observations and reference data
outputs: verified comparison dataset and specified method settings

steps.what: Prepare repeated processing comparisons and inspect their actual errors and residuals in photogrammetric survey software {OTHER}
inputs: verified comparison dataset and specified method settings
outputs: actual source-linked method comparison results and failed runs

steps.what: Interpret the research results and write and check the findings, applicability limits and further questions
inputs: actual source-linked method comparison results and failed runs
outputs: checked final surveying-method findings and internal destination

steps.what: Save the checked actual surveying-method research findings in the internal research folder
inputs: checked final surveying-method findings and internal destination

tasks.design: Use native saved literature queries and reusable comparison configurations in photogrammetric survey software {OTHER}. Keep research design, source verification, interpretation and findings human; reusable settings reduce repeated setup and table arrangement, not software runtime.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparable research runs can require repeated configuration and result-table assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved settings and source-linked comparison tables can reuse explicit experimental choices.
tasks.still_hard: Separating a genuine method improvement from dataset or calibration effects.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing a meaningful comparison and explaining its limits.

ambition.what: Compare one additional explicitly defined parameter setting within an existing research question.

tasks.altitude: More attention to method validity, unchanged professional authority.

reach.task: Evaluate whether a mapping method suits a dataset
reach.learn: Interpret residuals alongside source quality and coverage.

evidence.claim: Native reusable photogrammetric processing settings and comparison tables can reduce repeated human setup and result arrangement.

assumptions: Boundary is desk-based method research using existing actual datasets. New field measurement, image acquisition and software runtime receive no saving and are not assumed free inputs when a project requires them.

Dataset owners supply actual image IDs, control observations, coordinate reference system, units, calibration revision and source quality. The surveyor supplies method settings and comparison criteria. Missing data or incompatible units are manually resolved before comparisons.

Test native saved configurations and comparison tables before custom code. No model conducts research or interprets residuals. The 40% processing-step reduction is only repeated setup and result-table handling; computational waiting is excluded.
a1 binds the complete actual findings, limitations and destination checked in s5. Edits require rechecking; no external paper submission or message is included.
unknowns: Current configuration reuse and actual repeated setup time.
research_questions: Do native saved comparisons preserve exact dataset and calibration provenance?

already_counted.description: Inspect actual comparison results and write and check findings.

incremental.description: Maintain reusable method settings and verify source-version compatibility.

approvals.approved_version: Complete actual method findings, source and configuration references, limitations and internal destination checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Reference work saves 6 points and repeated human comparison setup 12; gross 18 less 1.5 upkeep. Native facilities already in use or missing source structure give no new saving and no deployment.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine aerial photography equipment specifications and altitudes.

steps.what: Confirm the required aerial photography detail, accuracy, area and actual operating constraints
Assess actual camera and sensor capability, calibration, terrain variation and available platform limitations
inputs: actual equipment specifications and calibration records
terrain model in survey planning software {OTHER}

steps.what: Calculate candidate photographic altitudes, ground resolution and overlap using explicit equipment and terrain parameters
outputs: calculated acquisition options and explicit constraint exceptions

steps.what: Determine and write the final equipment specifications and photographic altitudes, checking calculations, terrain limits and operating constraints
inputs: calculated acquisition options and explicit constraint exceptions
outputs: checked final aerial equipment and altitude specification and internal location

steps.what: Save the checked final aerial photography specification in the internal survey project record
inputs: checked final aerial equipment and altitude specification and internal location

tasks.design: Configure native camera geometry, ground resolution and overlap calculations in survey planning software {OTHER}. The surveyor verifies actual inputs and chooses and checks the equipment and altitude specification; the calculation is neither a flight authorization nor an automatic flight command.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparing camera geometry and terrain-dependent options can require repeated calculation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native explicit geometry tools can recompute the same requirements from verified parameters.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling image requirements with terrain, equipment and operational limits.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing a defensible specification and recognizing when an option is impractical.

ambition.what: Compare a terrain-sensitive acquisition option before finalizing the specification.

tasks.altitude: Less repeated arithmetic, unchanged survey and operating authority.

reach.task: Check an acquisition specification against mapping accuracy needs
reach.learn: Relate resolution, overlap and terrain to usable image geometry.

evidence.claim: Native survey planning tools can calculate camera geometry and overlap from explicit parameters.

assumptions: Boundary is determining equipment and altitude specifications. It does not duplicate directing actual acquisition under 3549 or include flying, permits or procurement.

Equipment owners supply sensor dimensions, pixel size, focal length and calibration revision; project owners supply area and required resolution; authoritative terrain data supplies heights and vertical datum. The surveyor verifies units and actual platform limits. Missing or inconsistent inputs go to manual calculation and review.

Try native planning tools before code. No model selects equipment or approves a flight. Calculation runtime earns no labour saving; only repeated human calculation and option-table handling are reduced.
a1 binds the finished specification and exact internal destination checked in s4. Edits require rechecking, and saving earns no benefit.
unknowns: Current native geometry usage and time spent on manual option calculations.
research_questions: Can native geometry calculations preserve unit, datum and terrain assumptions explicitly?

already_counted.description: Review calculated options and determine and check the final specification.

incremental.description: Maintain verified camera parameters and test unit and datum compatibility.

approvals.approved_version: Complete final aerial equipment and photographic-altitude specification, assumptions and internal destination checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only 35 points of repeated human calculation fall to 50%; gross 17.5 less 1.5 upkeep. Low is no deployment when native calculations are already used or inputs need manual resolution.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop design and modification criteria for survey instruments.

steps.what: Gather actual instrument-use problems, measurement needs and environmental constraints from users and observed work
Investigate current instrument performance, calibration evidence and limits relevant to the proposed design or modification
outputs: checked performance evidence and design gaps

steps.what: Develop criteria for the design and modification of survey instruments, choosing justified accuracy, usability and robustness requirements
inputs: checked performance evidence and design gaps

steps.what: Write and check the complete criteria record, evidence links, testability and unresolved limits
inputs: checked performance evidence and design gaps
outputs: checked final instrument-criteria record and project destination

steps.what: Save the checked final instrument design criteria in the internal project record
inputs: checked final instrument-criteria record and project destination

tasks.design: Configure a native requirements form in {PROJECT} that reuses instrument identity, source links and existing criteria headings. Keep gathering needs, interpreting performance and choosing and checking every substantive criterion with the surveyor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Criteria records can repeat basic instrument and evidence references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked forms can reuse those fields without generating engineering requirements.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing testable criteria that address real measurement and use problems.
tasks.human_edge: Trading off precision, field usability and robustness.

ambition.what: No automatic instrument design or new approval authority is proposed.

tasks.altitude: Slightly less record assembly, unchanged design judgement.

reach.task: Relate a design criterion to a verifiable measurement
reach.learn: Write tolerances and conditions so a test can actually assess them.

evidence.claim: Native requirements forms can reuse identity and evidence references while keeping engineering criteria human-authored.

assumptions: Boundary is developing criteria and their actual record, not designing, modifying or calibrating the instrument. No physical engineering or test-execution saving is claimed.

Users and the surveyor supply actual problems and needs; equipment and calibration owners supply instrument ID, revision, conditions, actual performance evidence and source links. Missing evidence requires manual investigation; no threshold is invented by a model.
Test native forms before code. Only repeated identity, headings and references account for the 15% writing-step reduction; actual criterion wording and complete checking remain human.
The normal author check in s4 binds a1 to the finished criteria, rationale and exact project record. Edits require rechecking. Saving retains full time.
unknowns: Whether criteria records already reuse these fields.
research_questions: Does native reference reuse shorten the existing record without adding documentation requirements?

already_counted.description: Write and check the substantive criteria record.

incremental.description: Maintain basic requirements fields and evidence-link mappings.

approvals.approved_version: Complete final instrument criteria, rationale, evidence references and project destination checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only 24 points of record assembly fall to 85%; gross 3.6 less 0.6 upkeep. No adoption if the current form already reuses fields; all substantive engineering remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The surveyor retains field direction and engineering judgement while native tools reduce some layout, retrieval and explicit calculation work.
reach: Help technicians and photogrammetrists keep actual acquisition and test evidence traceable.
skills_to_grow: Measure setup mechanics separately from runtime
role.ambitious_version: Review a real acquisition gap or method comparison earlier without lowering the evidence required for acceptance.
